Common mistakes
Mistake	Why it fails	Better move
Leaving features on very different scales	The penalty then treats equal effects differently.	Scale inputs using training data only.
Penalizing the intercept by accident	The baseline level is not a feature effect.	Keep the intercept outside the penalty.
Calling ridge feature selection	Ridge shrinks weigh

  return max(abs(signal) - penalty, 0) * (1 if signal >= 0 else -1)


for signal in [3, 0.7]:

Treating one selected feature as uniquely important	Correlated inputs can substitute for each other.	Check selection stability across resamples.
Skipping feature scaling	Penalty strength depends on feature units.	Standardize inside each training fold.

Reading alpha endpoints incorrectly	Alpha 1 is lasso; alpha 0 is ridge.	Check the objective before configuring a library.
